items.text: Raymond James contrasts its culture, service and platform with competitors that compete with the largest check, and contrasts its commitment to independence with competitors that change comp plans to cross-sell bank products.
items.quote: We attract and retain financial advisors with our unique culture, leading service, and robust platform, whereas many of our competitors compete with the largest check. We value independence to foster an environment where our advisors can provide objective advice to their clients, whereas many of our competitors change their comp plans every year to cross-sell more bank products.

items.text: Raymond James contrasts its AI approach, empowering advisors to better serve clients, with competitors using AI to bypass advisors and go direct to clients.
items.quote: we're really wanting to use AI to help our financial professionals and our financial advisors better serve their clients, where many of our competitors have used technology and are planning on using AI to essentially try to get around their financial advisors to go direct to their clients.

items.text: Raymond James says advisors from the largest firms expect to downgrade on technology when joining for the culture but find the technology is an upgrade.
items.quote: they tell us, 'Wow, we thought we were going to have to downgrade in terms of technology to join Raymond James because you guys have such a great culture.' But I am now realizing after spending a day or two with your technology that it's actually going to be an upgrade.

items.text: Raymond James contrasts its commitment to remaining independent and its technology investment with competitors whose technology investment is a fraction of its own.
items.quote: they want a platform and a home that can remain independent. And we're absolutely committed to remaining independent... a lot of our competitors who also are focused on personal relationships, and that have similar cultures, their technology investment, for example, is a fraction of ours.

items.text: Raymond James contrasts its technology spend, focused on financial advisors and clients, with bigger firms whose technology spend must cover credit cards, payments and treasury banking.
items.quote: there are some bigger firms out there that have higher technology spend, they have to focus on credit cards, payments, treasury banking a lot -- a whole host of other priorities, whereas most of our technology spend is really focused on supporting the financial advisers and their clients

items.text: Raymond James contrasts its multiple, established affiliation options and largest addressable market with firms for whom such models are new ventures.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market across our affiliation options, from employee to independent contractor to the RIA custody, and we have critical mass and decades of experience in all of them. It's not a new venture for us.
